title: an is_numeric() guard makes the int half of a string|int parameter unreachable

ground_truth.statement: is_numeric() is true for every int, so an int argument always takes the early return and the value that reaches accept_string() is a string. Passing the parameter to a string parameter after the guard is sound; the declared parameter type of accept_string() is the runtime witness.

notes: Sound-code case from the field: a legacy codebase guards `int|string` with is_numeric(). Every diagnostic here is a false positive; PHPStan and Psalm are expected to be silent because the int alternative is removed by the guard.
